column1: # Chapter 3 — Ribeira road: Oscar and Jeru recruitments / arena lead
# Group 208 (000BD126-000BF47A). Branch alternatives are retained as separate records.

column2: Why...?
Why did you show mercy not only to those white-$$羽$$ $$奴隷$$s...
but even to enemies like me and the $$盗賊$$s...?
Why did you spare us?!
On a battlefield, black $$羽$$ and white $$羽$$ make no difference to me...
But judging from what you said earlier, before you tore off those $$羽$$...
you were a white-$$羽$$ $$奴隷$$ too, weren't you?!
I can tell, even if you try to hide it!
You're wearing a $$邪道騎士$$'s armor, yet you still talk so humbly...
And after saying things like that, any idiot would catch on!!
Nyaah, dummy! Dummy!!
That's not what I meant!
Put simply, these people are utterly wicked criminals...
They truly believe in $$邪教の教え$$—ideas like $$正義$$, $$自由$$, $$愛$$, and $$平等$$...!
Those $$奴隷$$s did not attack us of their own will...
And aside from their leader, the other $$盗賊$$s seemed merely desperate to survive...
Besides, the way you reacted just now...
Wanting to spare us instead of killing us was something truly outrageous...
That sort of wickedness may be why you saved them...
Even you, a $$邪道騎士$$...
Are you treated just like the others because of that feeling you call $$平等$$...?
Then could I perhaps... join your group as well...?
Hey... what do we do?!
Let him join
Do not let him join
You have my thanks...!
Ever since I was born...
I have only wanted to know how far my own strength would take me in this world...
That is why I have lived as a $$傭兵$$ until now...
At the very least...
I will do my best not to get in the way in battle!
$$オスカー$$ has joined the party!
I see...
It cannot be helped.
It seems the path I should choose is one I must find for myself...!
H-hey, aren't you $$ダロム$$?!
Why are you a $$盗賊$$?!
That town is finished! Since the new $$領主$$ took over, prices have shot through the roof,
and you need a fortune just to get by!
What about everyone? What has become of the people in town?
It's a miserable mess.
There are only two kinds of people in town now: those who do anything for money, and those who have it taken from them.
My master could no longer make a living, so he was driven out of town...
Then I'll kill that $$領主$$ myself all over again!!
M-more importantly, $$レブ$$...
That guy is at the $$闘技場$$...
He's shown up again...!!
He's...
still alive...?
$$ダロム$$!! Come with me too!
N-no, it's all right.
I'm weak. I do not think I can live with as much $$自由$$ as you do.
And besides... I can't go...
My vision is already... going blurry...
Hey, $$ダロム$$...
F-$$自由$$, you say?!
I'll go find a new $$ご主人様$$ in another town.
That's what I'll do.
F-$$自由$$, you say?!
Thank you very much. You are strong, Sir Knight!
Naturally. Who do you think I am?!
When it comes to a $$大義賊$$ who has killed two hundred people...
There is one thing I must ask of you.
If we white-$$羽$$ $$奴隷$$s walk alone without a $$ご主人様$$...
we are captured as $$逃亡奴隷$$s, thrown into prison, or put up for $$競売$$...
The others say they are going to another town, but...
Would you make me your $$奴隷$$?!
Your status is no longer that of either a white-$$羽$$ or a black-$$羽$$!
In the eyes of the world, you are an adventurer called a $$邪道騎士$$.
If you want a $$奴隷$$, I see no reason why you cannot have one!
I'm against adding any more women...
If we're taking someone in, I'd rather it be someone with more $$戦力$$!
Yeah, yeah!!
Hey, you don't get to say that!
So what will you do?
Let her join
Do not let her join
Honestly...
I cannot understand what you people are thinking at all!
Just what I'd expect from a $$邪教徒$$! You commit $$罪$$ful kindness without fearing even the gods!!
I have to write this in my $$日記$$!
Thank you very much.
My name is $$ジェル$$!
I was a $$盗賊$$ for a long time, so I am confident in battle!
$$ジェル$$ has joined the party!
Please do not worry about it!!
I am sorry for suddenly making such an unreasonable request.
It was only because you were so wonderful, Sir Knight!
For now, I will head to town with everyone else.
Well, well... Nearly all of them got themselves killed.
Poor $$盗賊$$s. Never even knew I was pulling their strings...
Still, that armor...
I had my suspicions...
It really may become a threat to our $$教団$$!!
I'm weak... I do not think I can live with as much $$自由$$ as you do...
Sorry, everyone...
There is somewhere I need to stop by...
Hmm...
You intend to head for that $$闘技場$$ you mentioned, alone...?!
Word has it...
The people who live in that town must attend the large-scale gambling held at that $$闘技場$$ every weekend...
as customers, without fail...
And nearly all the money they win there is squeezed out of them by the $$領主$$, so I hear...
Then do you know where this $$領主$$
As I told you...
Today is the weekend, so he ought to be at the $$闘技場$$!
